name: MQTT Explorer
summary: The 0.3.5 source starts a crash reporter with uploadToServer set to true and no opt-out, sending error and stack-trace reports with platform, app version, and event data to the developer's host (master points to app-telemetry.t7n.de; the 0.3.5 tag points to localhost, so the shipped endpoint is unverified). The project's website says telemetry was removed, but neither the master nor the 0.3.5 source shows that.
